# Smart Import evaluation fixtures

Generated by `npx tsx functions/eval/generate.ts` (run from the repo root). Seeded and
deterministic: the same seed gives byte-identical files. **Do not edit by hand** — a unit test
regenerates every fixture in memory and fails if a file here differs.

Each fixture is built from a TRUTH (an invented cast, each query with a true status and a true
dated history), rendered into a messy file; `<id>.expected.json` is written from the truth, never
from the rendered file or a model run. `manifest.json` lists every fixture with its seed, knobs,
row count, `expectedToFail` (and why), and its `split` (`dev` or `holdout`).

Fixtures the current pipeline is expected to fail stay in the set, so a run measures the gap.

`real/` is gitignored. Put a real tracker there with a sibling `<name>.expected.json` (the
`ExpectedFile` shape in `functions/eval/types.ts`) to include it in runs; reports count real files
and never print their contents.

Names are invented.
